snippet.title: Obduction | Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Obduction. New worlds, from the creators of Myst and Riven. Available NOW.

Buy Obduction now:
Steam | https://store.steampowered.com/app/306760/Obduction/
Epic Games Store | https://store.epicgames.com/en-US/p/obduction
GOG | https://www.gog.com/en/game/obduction
Xbox | https://www.xbox.com/en-us/games/store/Obduction/9PBNTDXGXHB1
Mac App Store | https://apps.apple.com/us/app/obduction/id1183537149
Oculus Rift | https://www.oculus.com/experiences/rift/1272728086074533
Viveport | https://www.viveport.com/d3936b7b-1660-40b7-b7a6-f085dca249ae
Humble Bundle | https://www.humblebundle.com/store/obduction

As you walk through the woods on a pristine night, a curious, organic artifact falls from the starry sky and inexplicably, without asking permission, moves you across the universe. The answer to your questions about where you are, and why you’re here, lie ahead. This is your story now.

Learn more at https://cyan.com/games/obduction/
